name: Maximum-Generated Expansion over Convex Sites
statement: If $B$ is maximum-generated and $S$ is a nonempty geodesically convex subset of its one-inclusion graph, then $(B\times\{0\})\cup(S\times\{1\})$ is maximum-generated. Equivalently, this holds when $S=B\cap F$ for a coordinate face $F$, including positioned cubes; $B$ and $S$ then have nested consecutive-rank maximum parents with a common mark.
proof: In an ample class, nonempty geodesically convex subsets are exactly coordinate-face traces. Encode the face equalities by joining a three-word maximum path along each fixed coordinate. The resulting maximum-generated class has projection $B$ and full reduction $S$. Projection--reduction gluing produces the expansion, and the nested-parent construction gives the consecutive ranks.
